t: This is St Chad's Street, a street in the London Borough of Camden. It takes its name from Chad of Mercia, a prominent seventh-century Anglo-Saxon monk. Chad served as an abbot, then as Bishop of the Northumbrians, and later as Bishop of the Mercians and Lindsey People. After his death he came to be known as a saint, which is why his name is still found on street signs like this one today.
